slice: Locate branch-history mispredictions with reused IN output storage

decision.finding: Of 6792 recorded hot-loop misprediction entries, 6576 (96.82%) originate at the no-candidate-tag branch. Full-key equality accounts for 65 (0.96%) and the inner packing loop for 108 (1.59%). This identifies the dominant recorded branch in the reused-buffer path, without explaining its changing prediction behavior.
decision.scope: Finite, potentially overlapping branch histories sampled on branch misses. These are not unique retired branch counts, population misprediction rates, or evidence that the optional type-inference patch increases execution cost.

method.question: Which branch instructions carry sampled misprediction flags in the allocation-free reused-buffer lookup/packing path?
method.implementation: Reuse the preceding byte-identical executable with buffer mode 2. No Rust rebuild or source changes. Use the existing gated perf record and branch-history decoders. Map the outlined loop at ELF 0x51bba0 (444 bytes) to its disassembly before collection.
method.design: Exactly four groups of four processes, two native seed inputs crossed with both ABBA/BAAB execution orders, keeping the earlier profile schedule preparation rotations. Each process retains one table, performs 32 warmups and 1044 full-input executions. Eight smoke processes with one warmup and 12 executions must pass first. perf record uses branch-misses:u, period 10007, branch filter any,u,save_type, 64 mmap pages, CLOCK_MONOTONIC and user-space branch histories.
method.analysis: Retain all decoded samples and branch histories. Compare sample identities across both decoders, profile periods, phase bounds and lost records. Report all process-level and aggregate counts by source branch offset and speculation flag. Compare every occupied table slot within groups. No elapsed-time effect estimate or population misprediction rate from finite, overlapping, miss-triggered histories.
method.stopping_rule: One fixed collection. No profile-dependent extensions, discarded runs, seed changes or extra warmups. During profiling, monitor only owned output. No global setting or shared source/executable change.
limits: Profiles can perturb prediction state. Branch histories locate recorded mispredictions without identifying why apparently matching processes differ.
This is not a type-inference candidate comparison and does not resolve the original release timing interval.

hotspot.name: Float64 diagnostic_collect_into lookup inside the outlined Vec word-packing fold

source_audit.scope: Diagnostic overlay only. Original contains(), constructor, native table/hash/equality and input generation are unchanged. Fresh/reuse call one non-inlined helper; both omit BooleanArray/Arc wrapping. A capacity guard plus clear/extend within capacity avoids output Vec allocation in reuse. Validation checks stable pointer/capacity and every result bit. Native Column::evaluate clones its existing ArrayRef and ColumnarValue::into_array returns that array.
source_audit.limits: Fresh/reuse packing uses the same source loop as Arrow but is a new compiled function. Native-to-diagnostic comparisons also change result wrapping and code layout; no allocation-only speedup claim.

reproduction.setup: Reuse the exact referenced executable and prior scripts. Add perf --branch-filter any,u,save_type. Freeze the branch decoder after the existing smoke data passes. Keep every prediction and speculation flag and compare sample identities to the ordinary decoder. The archive retains raw perf bytes, raw branch text, all captures, frozen scripts, disassembly and source identities.
